name: Sadqay Tumhare
description: An arranged engagement between a village girl and her city cousin shows signs of true love, but an indiscretion decades ago could doom their romance.

videos.title: Episode 01
videos.overview: Shano hopes to finally meet Khalil, her fiance since they were kids, at a family wedding. But Khalil would rather play cricket than attend the event.

videos.title: Episode 02
videos.overview: Shano's relatives encourage her to make a romantic gesture toward Khalil before they meet, but her mother, Rasheeda, tries to put a stop to it.

videos.title: Episode 03
videos.overview: Khalil and Shano see each other for the first time. Khalil's father asks Amin for Shano's hand. Khalil makes his intentions clear to Shano's parents.

videos.title: Episode 04
videos.overview: Shano tells Humaira why she thinks her parents don't want to marry Khalil. Maqsood advises Khalil to swallow his pride. Two suitors visit Shano.

videos.title: Episode 05
videos.overview: Shano and Khalil have their first conversation. Khalil jockeys for position with Fayaz and slips a letter to Shano. Amin learns of Khalil's visit.

videos.title: Episode 06
videos.overview: Shano seeks religious advice. When Khalil's parents visit Shano's to ask for her hand in marriage, an unexpected guest joins the conversation.

videos.title: Episode 07
videos.overview: Humaira becomes suspicious when Rasheeda doesn't allow her to see Shano. Rasheeda makes plans for Shano. Khalil receives a reply to his letter.

videos.title: Episode 08
videos.overview: On his way to Shano's home, Khalil is stopped by Fayaz and his friends. Upon hearing what has happened, Shano threatens to take drastic measures.

videos.title: Episode 09
videos.overview: Fayaz's father asks the priest to broker a peace between Khalil and his son. Khalil asks Rasheeda why she wants to get revenge against his family.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: At Rasheeda's insistence, Amin asks Fayaz's parents to force a marriage between Shano and Fayaz. Khalil shocks Shano with a prediction.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The priest gives Khalil advice. Believing it is the only solution, Maqsood asks Khalil's father to consent to a court marriage for his son and Shano.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Khalil's mother recalls a past betrayal. Rasheeda asks a shaman for help. Shano and Khalil plan a rendezvous. Khalil loses his cool with Rasheeda.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Khalil proposes an idea to Shano. A party guest at Humaira's home starts trouble with Khalil. Rasheeda wakes up to find that Shano is missing.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Khalil is taken into custody by the police. Rasheeda tells Khalil's father that she will allow his son to marry Shano -- under one specific condition.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Shano tells her father she doesn't believe her mother's accusations. Maqsood convinces Khalil to accept an alternative. Shano gets an urgent message.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Maqsood and Khalil propose a plan to Shano. Shano's sister is found waiting to unlock the gate for Shano's return. A new suitor comes to court Shano.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Rasheeda assures Amin she has a way to force Shano's consent. A relative points out to Rasheeda a disadvantage to her plan she hadn't thought of.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: An informant visits Amin. Khalil's loyalty to his family is used as a weapon against him. Rasheeda pulls a stunt that forces Khalil to make a promise.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Humaira tells Shano of the odd exchange she had with Rasheeda the night before. Shano agrees to testify against Khalil if her father makes a promise.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Amin brings accusations against Khalil's father. Rasheeda tells Amin to make a false promise to Shano's grandmother in order to take Shano back home.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Amin takes a stand against Rasheeda. Humaira has a surprising conversation with Shano. Rasheeda reveals her true desires to Amin.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Misfortune befalls Amin. After being told of a premonition, Shano makes a difficult decision. Rasheeda behaves shamelessly in Amin's absence.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Humaira confesses her true feelings. Maqsood gives Shano a prognosis and tells her what she must do in order for her father to recover fully.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Humaira admits to her mother that there's a man she wants to marry. Khalil's mother decides to make a sacrifice. Khalil learns family secrets.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Shano shows compassion toward her mother. Khalil learns why he is expected to pay for another man's sins. Humaira writes Khalil a letter.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Believing he has inherited Sadiq's bad qualities, Khalil agrees to meet with Humaira. Khalil's mother begs Rasheeda for forgiveness.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Khalil's mother is inconsolable. Humaira seeks Shano's forgiveness. Khalil carries out Shano's wishes. The fates of Khalil and Shano are revealed.
